Smart brush v0.10: Forest + Heave
  • 🌲 Forest paints a tree layer on the ground. It never changes height: the height readout and the contour stay the same. + plants, − (or Ctrl/Shift) clears.
  • Zoomed out, Forest is a dark canopy texture. Zoom in close and small 3D trees stand on it (trees are drawn oversized so you can see them; capped at 12,000 trees on screen).
  • ⇕ Heave raises or lowers the land only. Trees stay on their ground and keep their shape; Paint and the overlay wrinkles ride along. Under the sea the trees hide; heave back up and the same trees return.
  • Forest variations: Upright or Lean with slope (trees tip with the ground, exaggerated so it shows).
  • Elevation is still here for comparison (it also makes the overlay wrinkles bigger as land rises; Heave does not).
Contour overlay (from PoC v0.1)
  • ETOPO only = the v0.9 globe. + Overlay = sculpted height maps added on top. One globe; the switch flips it.
  • Rolling soft hills · Crisp stepped banks · Grain fine ripples. % = strength.
  • It is real height, not paint: the hill shading lights it, and River, Erode and Plateau cut it (River flattens it in the bed and leaves it on the banks).
  • Ridge and Elevation: raised land gets bigger wrinkles as it rises, so a new range has its own folds.
  • Variations: tap a smart brush (Ridge, River…) and a tray opens above the row with named looks. Pick one, then tweak it with ⚙ as before. Tap the brush again to close.
  • Zoom in and finer wrinkles fade in; zoom out and they fade away. No giant hills close up.
  • The 3 maps are sculpted by a small script (noise, then water erosion) when the page opens, then tiled over the globe at several sizes. Not Earth data, not hand-painted. No other procedural detail is added on Earth.
